setupCard.description: Connect your Shoper shop with its API token.

shoperConnectionActions.description: Registers a webhook in Shoper so new and changed orders and products reach OpenLinker right away. Needs the OL callback URL and the Order source or Product master capability; run it again after enabling one of them.
shoperConnectionActions.title: Configure webhooks

configured.description: Shoper will now notify OpenLinker when an order or a product is created or changes.
configured.title: Webhooks configured

failed.notAccepted: Shoper did not accept the webhook registration.
failed.title: Webhook registration failed

positiveInteger.shoperCancelledStatusId: The cancelled status id must be a positive whole number.
positiveInteger.shoperInProgressStatusId: The in-progress status id must be a positive whole number.
positiveInteger.shoperParcelShippingId: The parcel delivery method id must be a positive whole number.
positiveInteger.shoperPaymentId: The payment method id must be a positive whole number.
positiveInteger.shoperShippingId: The delivery method id must be a positive whole number.
positiveInteger.shoperStatusId: The order status id must be a positive whole number.

shoperCancelledStatusId.description: The status an order moves to when OpenLinker cancels it in the shop. Not set: the first active cancelled-type status.
shoperCancelledStatusId.label: Status for cancelled orders

shoperInProgressStatusId.description: The status an order moves to when OpenLinker reports it in progress. Not set: the first active in-progress status.
shoperInProgressStatusId.label: Status for orders in progress

shoperParcelShippingId.description: Used for the parcel when OpenLinker marks an order as shipped. The order's own delivery method is tried first. If Shoper refuses it (it does for some carrier-integrated methods, such as InPost or DPD), this method is used instead, so pick a plain one. Not set: the first plain method in the shop.
shoperParcelShippingId.label: Delivery method for shipments

shoperPaymentId.description: Shoper requires a payment method and OpenLinker has no payment mapping, so this is the one used for every order.
shoperPaymentId.label: Default payment method

shoperShippingId.description: Used when an order's delivery method has no mapping. Shoper requires one to create the order.
shoperShippingId.label: Default delivery method

shoperStatusId.description: Used when the order's status has no mapping. Pick the status new orders should start in.
shoperStatusId.label: Default order status

shoperOrderDefaultsSection.loadFailed: Could not load the list from Shoper

notReceivingOrders.body: Delivery, payment and status defaults are needed only when this shop receives orders. Enable the Order processor capability to set them.
notReceivingOrders.title: Order defaults

shoperOrderDefaultsSection.storedId: Saved id {id} (not in the shop's list)

callbackUrl.description: OpenLinker's public URL as Shoper can reach it. Shoper calls it when an order or a product changes. Pre-filled with the API address this app uses; it must be reachable from the internet. Required for the 'Configure webhooks' action.
callbackUrl.label: OL callback URL

noWebhookCapability.body: Webhooks deliver orders when Order source is enabled on this connection and product changes when Product master is. Enable one of them first, then configure webhooks.
noWebhookCapability.title: Nothing here uses webhooks
